title: Rollback-safe adaptive Richards research Reference for realistic daily forcing
central_question: Can the same R128 Richards physics complete the frozen realistic Hupsel workload under rollback-safe solver-failure step halving, without the short-horizon representation-floor fallback gate?

authority.reference_model_limitation: src/adapter/mod_b1_10_reference_model.f90 remains not generally admitted because scalar temporal policy/recoverable-failure authority is incomplete

retry_contract: Each failed solver attempt starts from the bit-identical accepted origin of that subinterval.
Only solver failure authorizes step halving.
No failed candidate state is committed.
Accepted trial must satisfy the existing hard mass gate <=1e-12 cm.
No representation-floor residual gate is used because that gate belongs to the short-horizon fallback qualification, not solver acceptance.
No solver tolerance, constitutive law, forcing value or material parameter is altered.

qualification.completion: A32 and A64 must complete all six materials and both HR72/HR86 histories.
qualification.repeatability: O2 repeated trajectory identity for each policy.
qualification.temporal_characterization: Report A32-vs-A64 daily storage/profile metrics without imposing an application threshold.
qualification.reference_selection: A32 may become P6B target only if complete/repeatable for all six. Otherwise A64 is not automatically promoted; close blocked.

candidate_firewall: S4 candidate output is not consumed during RNP02 selection.
